description: Get metadata about the current Obsidian vault.

returns.description: A dictionary containing status and output. On success, output is the vault object.

description: List notes in the vault, optionally filtered by folder prefix and/or tag.

folder.description: Optional folder path prefix to filter notes by.

tag.description: Optional tag to filter notes by (case-insensitive).

returns.description: A dictionary containing status and output. On success, output has count and results (notes sorted by modified_at desc).

description: Get a single note (metadata and content) by its vault path.

path.description: The vault-relative path of the note (e.g. 'Projects/Auth v2.md').

returns.description: A dictionary containing status and output. On success, output is the note with content; on failure (not found), output contains an error message.

description: Create a new note at the given path with the provided content.

path.description: The vault-relative path for the new note.

content.description: The markdown content of the new note.

returns.description: A dictionary containing status and output. On success, output is the created note with content; on failure (already exists), output contains an error message.

description: Replace or append to a note's content by its path.

path.description: The vault-relative path of the note to update.

content.description: Optional new full content to replace the note body.

append.description: Optional text to append to the existing note body.

returns.description: A dictionary containing status and output. On success, output is the updated note with content; on failure, output contains an error message.

description: Delete a note by its vault path.

path.description: The vault-relative path of the note to delete.

returns.description: A dictionary containing status and output. On success, output has deleted and path; on failure (not found), output contains an error message.

description: Search notes by matching the query in title, path, or body.

content.description: When true, include a matching-line snippet for body matches (default false).

returns.description: A dictionary containing status and output. On success, output has count, query, and results with match_in details.

description: List notes that wiki-link back to the given note.

path.description: The vault-relative path of the target note.

returns.description: A dictionary containing status and output. On success, output has path, count, and backlinks.

description: Get the daily note for a given date (Daily/<date_str>.md).

date_str.description: The date string used to locate the daily note (e.g. '2026-05-26').

returns.description: A dictionary containing status and output. On success, output is the daily note with content; on failure (not found), output contains an error message.
